title: Global existence of weak solutions for the Maxwell--Stefan system in the whole space
summary: We prove the global-in-time existence of weak solutions to the isothermal Maxwell--Stefan system on the whole space $\mathbb R^3$. The main difficulty is that, unlike in bounded domains, the concentrations generally have infinite mass and the standard mixing entropy is not finite. We therefore work with the relative entropy with respect to a strictly positive constant equilibrium state. The proof proceeds by solving the problem on balls $B_R$ with no-flux boundary conditions, using the bounded-domain entropy theory, and deriving estimates independent of $R$.
